primary_gt.check_sentence: All three arid-pulse checks pass: 24 mm is 14.12 times the 1.7 mm typical annual rainfall, the strongest gridded peak is 41.2 mm, and two gridded products have event-window peaks at or above 30 mm.

notes: The off-event daily point-weather fill is intentionally not used for the official answer.
Rainfall-pulse support is scored from the incident report and declared package-relative gridded precipitation summaries.

criteria.description: Returns arid_pulse_confirmed as the final deterministic class.
criteria.name: Final classification
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for a passing class with a vague label; award 0-1 point if the label conflicts with the threshold ledger.

criteria.description: Computes 24 divided by 1.7 and reports about 14.12 with the correct pass state.
criteria.name: Annual-equivalent ratio
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for minor rounding error; award 1 point for identifying the inputs without the quotient.

criteria.description: Reports 41.2 mm for the strongest gridded peak summary and counts 2 gridded products with event-window peaks at or above 30 mm.
criteria.name: Rainfall accumulation values
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one correct value; award 1 point for listing peak products without applying the support-count rule.

criteria.description: Marks annual_ratio, peak_accumulation, and product_support as true and links the class to all three inequalities.
criteria.name: Threshold ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct booleans without the inequality logic, or for one mistaken boolean with sound calculations.

criteria.description: Reports at least 26 killed, 120 missing, and homes_affected_at_least equal to 8000.
criteria.name: Impact anchor arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct casualty counts or correct housing sum, but not both.

criteria.description: Uses the requested compact JSON fields and a one-sentence computed check.
criteria.name: Compact output
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for correct values in a less compact format or with a diffuse explanation.
